description: A Java source file defining an Android ListActivity with a custom ListAdapter and custom view for displaying speeches, including toggle functionality for expanding/collapsing dialogue text.

classes.name: List6
classes.description: Main activity class extending ListActivity, managing a list of speeches with toggleable dialogue views.

classes.name: SpeechListAdapter
classes.description: Custom adapter extending BaseAdapter to provide speech items with toggleable expanded state.

classes.name: SpeechView
classes.description: Custom LinearLayout view representing a speech with title and dialogue, supporting expand/collapse.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets the custom list adapter.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Handles list item clicks to toggle dialogue expansion.

methods.name: SpeechListAdapter(Context)
methods.description: Constructor initializing context and data arrays.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns the position as the item.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns the position as the item ID.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Creates or reuses SpeechView for each list item, setting title, dialogue, and expansion state.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles the expanded state of a speech at a given position and refreshes the list.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title text in SpeechView.

methods.name: setDialogue
methods.description: Sets the dialogue text in SpeechView.

methods.name: setExpanded
methods.description: Expands or collapses the dialogue in SpeechView.
